notes.title: Update Base AI Model
notes.notes:
I've updated the base AI model, which has nearly doubled the processing speed and reduced VRAM usage. 

In exchange, there has been a slight decrease in accuracy, but we plan to continue fine-tuning this.

notes.title: Add Shapes Control and Translation Update
notes.notes:
I have updated the demo version as below;


Add Shapes Control in Main Game Scene
You can command about shapes for some operations, such as "Cut out", "Cut at angle" and so on.
Translation Update
Translation is updated. In particular, the translation of narrative text has been updated to sound more natural.

notes.title: Demo Release and Notice
notes.notes:
The demo version was released on July 2, 2025!

You can play up to stage 2 of easy mode, so please give it a try!



2025/8/15 Update

In response to the comments, I have made the following updates.

- Added a feature to check ingredients purchased and used

- Added a feature to check skills acquired and used

- Added a feature to sort ingredients and skills

- Fixed a bug that caused cooking class ingredients to be mixed with ingredients currently in your possession

- Other minor fixes



2025/7/16 Update

In response to the comments, I have made the following updates.

- Added a feature that allows AI to generate an appropriate name when the recipe name is blank

- Tutorial improvements

- Addressed an issue where text was not advanced, particularly in the English version, causing the text to be cut off

- Displays the number of days remaining until the weekend

- Fixed the position of the "steps" during cooking to make them easier to select

- Other minor fixes
